scope: Static inventory plus existing 2026-09-29 Python 3.14 wheel XML; no new execution or mutation testing.

functions.name: test_algorithm_offspring_and_history_keep_problem_weights
decorators: pytest.mark.parametrize('factory,nObj', [(f, 1) for f in SO_FACTORIES] + [(f, 2) for f in MO_FACTORIES])

functions.name: test_single_history_uses_feasibility_first_comparison
decorators: pytest.mark.parametrize('oldObj,oldCons,newObj,newCons,expectedNew', [(0, [10], 100, [1], True), (100, [1], 0, [10], False), (100, [1], 0, [1], False), (0, [1], 100, [0], True), (100, [0], 0, [1], False), (100, [-1], 0, [0], True), (0, [0], 100, [-1], False), (100, None, 0, None, True)])

functions.name: test_all_search_algorithms_keep_unit_population_and_export_real_solutions
decorators: pytest.mark.parametrize('factory,nObj', [(f, 1) for f in SO_FACTORIES] + [(f, 2) for f in MO_FACTORIES])

functions.name: testOptimizationCommonConfigurationUsesLiveAttributes
decorators: pytest.mark.parametrize('key,value', [('maxIters', 2), ('maxFEs', 30), ('maxTolerates', 3), ('tolerate', None), ('verboseFlag', True), ('verboseFreq', 3), ('logFlag', True), ('saveFlag', True), ('saveFreq', 2), ('historyFreq', None)])

functions.name: test_invalid_configuration_is_rejected
decorators: pytest.mark.parametrize('factory', [lambda: StandardScaler(sitaX=0), lambda: StandardScaler(sitaX=-1), lambda: StandardScaler(muX=np.nan), lambda: StandardScaler(sitaX=np.inf), lambda: MinMaxScaler(1, 1), lambda: MinMaxScaler(2, 1), lambda: MinMaxScaler(0, np.inf)])

functions.name: test_invalid_split_parameters
decorators: pytest.mark.parametrize('factory', [lambda: KFold(1), lambda: KFold(2.5), lambda: RandSelect(0), lambda: RandSelect(100), lambda: RandSelect(np.nan)])

skip_sites.call: pytest.skip('MARS extension modules are not available in this environment.')
pytest.importorskip('UQPyL.surrogate.mars.mars', reason='MARS extension modules are not available in this environment.')
pytest.importorskip('UQPyL.surrogate.svr.support_vector_machine', reason='SVR extension module is not available in this environment.')
